1. Decisions for you: (a) carried, unchanged: can an essay container declare its comments and references as children so one export carries the whole essay, while agents can still file comments (srs-web#634)? Why it matters: two of your rulings collide. Options: A engine guard stops at declared children; B keep the snapshot bundle, widened to carry threads; C another path for agent comments; D nothing. Recommendation: A. Action needed: decide. Urgency: blocks srs-web#634. Record 42fcc319-2468-4e15-b529-2c13f9174af6 (draft). Action needed: decide (merge or close each). Urgency: low. Both are the same pattern as the 2026-11-05 note: no affirmed remedy means no mandate. Affirming fb1ed34b, or ratifying "An affirmed remedy is a recorded ruling for a group's mandate", would clear it. Also waiting: needs-input on srs-web#567, #626, #634, #709 (#709 is a P1 bug with no `Answers:` line yet).

Merged PR without a quorum line: srs-web#758. Needs-input: srs-web#709, #626, #634, #567 (no new reply). Blocked: srs-web#750, #751, #752, #426, semanticops.com#14. No red gates reported.
5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 1 open counted by group-state. Pause: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: none. Nothing new is `proposed` and ready in the group log (42fcc319 is a draft escalation, not ready).
6. Next: ready + wg:agent-editor: srs-web#634 and #626 (needs-input), #601 (an umbrella, not one PR); semanticops.com#62 and #57 (in progress), #14 (blocked). Top 3 in builder order: #601, semanticops.com#62, #57. Open group PRs in flight: srs-rust#1600, srs-web#759, #760. Budget left: 9. Queue running thin: 2 of the ready items wait on you and #601 is a tracking parent, so about 1 cycle of buildable work. Needs feeding from the open exercises or the spec-to-implementation drift list. Waits on you: the #634 decision, merge or close of srs-rust#1600 and srs-web#759/#760, the #709 answer. Local priorities: none set. Fed by the analyst: not needed.
6b. Exercises: none open.
7. What we learned: the owner-merge lane is the whole throttle: 3 PRs merged this cycle, none under the delegated budget, and the 2 reviewer rejections (#759, #760) are the same missing piece, an affirmed remedy as the mandate. This repeats the 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-07 notes; the pattern is now three reports old, so ratifying "An affirmed remedy is a recorded ruling for a group's mandate" (proposed) is the standing-order amendment that would let reviewed PRs flow. The useful/noisy/misleading line is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
